analysis.reasonEn: Shifted to wait-and-see from a 3-day consecutive buy signal. RSI slightly declined from 45.8 to 45.7 but remains consolidated in the neutral zone. MACD histogram continues to improve from 587.0947 to 1676.3239. Volume ratio increased to 1.39 (1.39x 5-day average), indicating potential for increased volatility. Current price at 54.3% of 52-week range, showing no clear directional bias. Trading sideways around SMA20 at 102,452 KRW and Bollinger Band middle line at 102,452 KRW, indicating a directional search phase.
